items.title: Daily Briefing
items.script: Here is your daily briefing. This study tests if Transformers are necessary for weight-space programming by having large language models (LLMs) either generate weights for fixed architectures or design new ones. Multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) often trains AI agents against a single large language model (LLM) that simulates human users. AI agents need better interpretability beyond just model weights, focusing on how they use multi-source context for decisions. Nvidia's stock price increased by nearly 4% after the company reported higher-than-expected earnings.
